map.intro:
Topic → responsible files ({n}), paths relative to `{root}`. Kept up to date by
Code Hub (`hub_map_update`, hooks); editing descriptions by hand works too.
map.too_big: {project}: {n} text files – too big for a map
map.report: {project}: {files} files in {topics} topics ({new} new, {removed} removed, {blank} without description)
note.project_links: Architecture, decisions, bugs and sessions of this project link here.
search.lookup_none: No match for “{query}” – search yourself, then hub_map_update.
search.no_index: Index not available (sqlite3 missing) – use hub_lookup.
session.import_commit: Import: {n} sessions of the last {days} days
hook.start: Code Hub: before searching, hub_lookup("topic") names the responsible files. Projects: {projects}.
hook.auto: Code Hub (automatic, probably responsible according to the map):
mcp.no_project: {path} is in no project (no git repo in the home folder) – not added.
mcp.needs_project: A relative path needs project (or give an absolute path).
vault.exists: {path} already exists – add it with “Add folder”.
vault.too_big: The whole home folder is too big for a vault.
vault.keep_hub: The Code Hub vault always stays.
vault.outside: The path is outside of the vault.
vault.protected: Code Hub rewrites this file itself – changes would be lost.
vault.changed: The file was changed elsewhere in the meantime (Obsidian or Claude).
view.changed: The file was changed in the meantime (Obsidian or Claude) – saving again overwrites it.
install.title: Setting up Code Hub
install.vault: Vault {path} (git repo, registered in Obsidian if installed)
install.importing: Importing the sessions of the last {days} days – projects appear along the way
install.mcp: MCP server “codehub” added for all projects
install.no_claude: claude not found – MCP server not added. By hand: claude mcp add --scope user codehub -- {command}
install.done:
Done. Start a new Claude session (running ones only see hooks and MCP after a restart).
Look at it: codehub open · Check: codehub doctor
uninstall.title: Removing Code Hub (the vault stays)
cli.no_vault: No vault yet – first: codehub install
cli.stats_asked: Hub asked: {asked} · free searches: {free} · hub share: {share} %
cli.stats_hits: Files read that the hub had named: {hits} of {reads} ({share} %)
cli.no_remote: No remote – the vault is only committed locally.
cli.remote_set: Remote: {url} – pushed there after every session.
cli.help.install: set up: vault, hooks, MCP server, rules
cli.help.uninstall: remove hooks, MCP and rules (the vault stays)
cli.help.open: open the view in the browser
cli.help.serve: run the view's web server in the foreground
cli.help.search: full text over notes, decisions, sessions
cli.help.add: map a folder as a project
cli.help.map: bring maps in line with the repos (--fresh: anew)
cli.help.index: update the search index (--rebuild: from scratch)
cli.help.tokens: token use today, 7 and 30 days, total
cli.help.stats: how often Claude asked the hub instead of searching
cli.help.bench: measure tokens with and without Code Hub (costs tokens)
cli.help.remote: show or set the vault's git remote
web.failed: The view could not start – codehub serve shows the error.
web.graph_hint: drag to turn · drag a node · right-drag to pan · wheel to zoom · double-click to fly
web.graph_empty: As soon as Claude works in a git repo, it shows up here. Or add a folder directly:
web.no_webgl: This browser cannot do it or has it turned off. Feed, sessions and tokens still work.
web.share_tip: How often Claude asked the hub first today instead of searching itself (grep, find, Glob).
web.hits_detail: files read that the hub had named
web.hits_tip: Of all files Claude opened today (right number): how many the hub had named before (left number).
web.feed_empty: As soon as Claude Code works, every step shows up here.
web.feed_no_hooks: Without them the feed only sees what is in the transcripts. Run this once in a terminal, then restart Claude Code:
web.no_description: No description yet – Claude adds one with hub_map_update.
web.cmd_failed: That did not work – is the view still running?
web.offline: Connection lost – codehub open starts the view again.
web.bars_hint: bars = used, hover for the day
web.tokens_foot: Every answer from Claude counts once – from all transcripts under ~/.claude/projects, subagents included. Used = your input + Claude's output + history newly written to the cache. Cache reads cost a tenth and are listed separately. Claude Code deletes transcripts after 30 days; the sums here stay.
web.s_language_hint: View, command line and the notes of new vaults
web.s_auto_hint: Up to 6 lines from the map, only for a clear match
web.s_start_hint: Projects and the last session, about 150 tokens
web.s_push_hint: Only with a git remote (codehub remote <url>)
web.s_logs_hint: Days, then the logs are deleted
web.hooks_on: Hooks are installed – the hub is counting.
web.hooks_off: Hooks are missing – run this once in a terminal:
bench.no_project: No project with a map yet – first codehub add <folder>.
bench.question: Which files in this project are responsible for “{topic}”? List the paths with one line of explanation each. Do not change anything.
bench.plan: Benchmark in {project}: {n} questions, {runs} runs of Claude Code (once with and once without Code Hub, read-only):
bench.confirm: This costs real tokens of your plan. Start?
bench.total: {project}, {n} questions: {saved} fewer tokens, {cost} lower cost, {turns_with} instead of {turns_without} steps.

license.format: That does not look like a license key – it is in your purchase email.
license.no_shop: The shop is not set up yet.
premium.not_ours: That is no Code Hub Premium package.
premium.bad_signature: The package was changed or is not from the publisher – it is not installed.
premium.needed: {feature} is part of Code Hub Premium: codehub premium
premium.no_package: The premium package is still missing: download it from your purchase email and run “codehub premium <key> <file.zip>” – or just leave it in Downloads.
premium.offer: Code Hub Premium – 3D graph, token statistics, benchmark, themes. Once {price}:
premium.offline: The shop cannot be reached – check the internet connection. {error}
update.git: A git folder ({path}) – use “git pull” there.
update.current: Code Hub {version} is up to date.
update.broken: The download is incomplete – nothing changed.
web.overview_hint: click for map, docs and recent sessions
web.no_knowledge: Nothing recorded yet – Claude writes them with hub_note.

web.premium_tokens: Token statistics show your use per day, month and project.

web.pf_bench: codehub bench: measures the savings on your code
web.pf_once: pay once, no subscription · up to {devices} computers
web.premium_package_hint: Download codehub-premium-….zip from your purchase email and drop it here.
web.key_placeholder: License key from your purchase email
